resources.string: Once a week the app makes a backup by itself, also when it\'s closed. Pick a folder on the phone, a copy on Google Drive, or both: only a copy off the phone helps if the phone is lost.
The three latest automatic backups stay there. Older automatic ones are removed, backups saved by hand never. When you pick it, create a folder such as \"Diecast Tracker\" in Documents.

Android doesn\'t give an app a Drive folder, so one file is written over every week. When you save it, open the ☰ menu at the top left and choose Drive: the save screen first opens the last folder used (another place off the phone works too).
This copy is on the phone too, so it won\'t help if the phone is lost. Choose where to save again and pick Drive in the ☰ menu.
Copying the backup to its places…
the folder can\'t be opened any more. Pick it again.
the file can\'t be written any more. Choose it again.
That place doesn\'t let the app write to it later. Choose another one.
The backup couldn\'t be written: see Automatic backup.
